name: Backend API Kernel / State Machine
purpose: Create the backend command, state, policy, workflow result, adapter, read model, and observability foundation.
laws: n8n workers may only return normalized results.
Each workflow result must be idempotent.
Every command must carry a correlation ID and idempotency key.
AI may suggest but must not govern hard blockers, payments, refunds, official status, fraud, privacy, or submissions.
Playwright is scout/probe only and must route blocked portals to MAP fallback.
No completion claim without validator and report.
